summary: Iteration 4 testing PASSED end-to-end for the two new features (Insurance-from-Lead and Lead Import column-mapping) plus regressions. Backend pytest: 17/17 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_mapping_and_lead_insurance.py. Frontend Playwright: (1) opened Lead 360 for LD26000001, switched to Insurance tab — Premium prefilled from lead (22000), Expected payout live-updated to ₹3,300 with rate=15, Add Insurance created entry INS26000103 which appeared in the list; (2) opened Lead Import drawer with a CUSTOM-header CSV (Name,Phone,Town,Vehicle,Sales Person,Budget), drawer advanced to mapping step (map-* selects rendered empty as expected because none of the custom headers match target field labels), setting map-customerName='Name' etc updated the preview and rowCount=2, commit-import-btn imported 2 leads (LD26000014 and LD26000015 status=New) shown in the register with a '2 leads imported' toast. Regressions verified: owner login+/api/auth/me, executive still blocked on /api/dealer-earnings (403), public /api/share/dashboard 200, price-master + scheme-master 200, GSheets status returns enabled=false canWrite=false while POST /api/leads and POST /api/insurance still return 200.
action_items: None required for functionality. Optional: main agent may POST /api/admin/reseed to remove residual closed TEST_UI_Map_* leads (LD26000014, LD26000015) — they are closed but still in DB. Insurance test entries were fully deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: import_preview/import_commit correctly accept `mapping` via multipart Form (fixes the prior query-param bug) — confirmed by test_preview_with_explicit_mapping and test_commit_with_mapping_creates_leads.
list_insurance lead_id filter query {leadId: lead_id} is correctly isolated — verified LD26000002 does NOT return LD26000001 entries.
_insurance_derive handles percent (15) and fraction (0.15) inputs uniformly — expectedPayout=premium*rate rounded to 2dp, status flips to Received/Partial correctly.
GSheets append is a graceful no-op (canWrite=false does not block writes to Mongo) — POST /api/leads and POST /api/insurance still return 200.
Frontend LeadImport.js correctly re-runs preview on every mapping change (changeMap) — verified rowCount updates live from 0 → 2 as user maps columns.
InsuranceTab premium pre-fills from lead.insuranceAmount (from price structure) — for LD26000001 prefilled 22000 and computed expected 3300 at 15%.
Minor nit (not blocking): when user hits Escape on the Lead 360 drawer it doesn't close (has to click X). Not a regression from this iteration.
